content: सारस्वत {%a.%} (-ती|{%f.%}) [सरस्वती देवतास्य, सरस्वत्या इदं वा अण्] .²1 Relating to the goddess Sarasvatī. .²2 Belonging to the river Sarasvatī; कृत्वा तासामभिगममपां सौम्य सारस्वतीनाम् <ls>Me. 51</ls>. .²3 Eloquent. .²4 Belonging to the Sāravata country. .{@-तः@} .²1 <ab>N.</ab> of a country about the river Sarasvatī. .²2 <ab>N.</ab> of a particular class of Brāhmaṇas. .²3 A particular ceremonial used in the worship of Sarasvatī. .²4 A staff of the Bilva tree. .²5 <ab>N.</ab> of a certain sage; सारस्वतश्चापि जगाद नष्टम् (वेदम्) <ls>Bu. Ch. 1. 48</ls>. .{@-ताः@} ({%m.%} <ab>pl.</ab>) The people of the Sārasvata country. .{@-तम्@} Speech, eloquence; शृङ्गारसारस्वतम् <ls>Gīt. 12</ls>.
